jobs.prompt: Create ONE portrait 9:16 background for a game boss scene inside a spaceship, no characters. UNIQUE setting: a derelict alien dairy fermentation BIOREACTOR chamber, NOT a cargo hold or post office. Rounded ribbed organic-mechanical walls, giant opaque cylindrical fermentation tanks embedded in left and right sides, copper cooling coils, thick translucent amber cheese-filled hoses, strange curved bone-like pipe fittings. Rear center: large CLOSED round industrial pressure hatch with radial bolts and an abstract triangular relief, no lettering. Low warm lamps, small dim teal status lights, diffuse muted olive purple and ochre palette. Floor is a circular grated maintenance platform with yellow cheese leaks around perimeter and a broad clear middle area for a separately composited boss. No windows, no space view, no planet, no purple vortex, no crates, no conveyor belt, no skyline, no rectangular loading bay. Hand drawn adult sci-fi cartoon like Rick and Morty / Futurama, fine irregular black outlines, flat textured cel shading, grungy but readable, restrained diffuse light, no glossy 3D or neon overload. Keep central 65% unobstructed. No text, labels, digits, UI or watermark. Full bleed opaque background.

Create ONE transparent animation sprite atlas, exact TWO equally sized square cells side by side, aspect ratio 2:1. TWO alien mouse creatures, full bodies entirely within their cells with 10% transparent padding. Same species and coherent hand drawn adult sci-fi cartoon style as Rick and Morty / Futurama: fine irregular black outlines, flat textured cel shading, muted palette. These are unmistakably EXTRATERRESTRIAL MICE, NOT normal Earth brown rats: squat lumpy dusty teal and muted purple skin with tiny patchy fur tufts, THREE bulging pale yellow eyes, oversized asymmetric translucent fin-shaped ears, six tiny clawed feet, thin segmented tail ending in a small fleshy bioluminescent lure. Funny ugly mischievous expressions. Each creature holding and chewing a small yellow Swiss cheese wedge, with little crooked teeth. LEFT CELL creature facing right, dusty teal body and purple fins; RIGHT CELL creature facing left, same species and palette, slightly different hunched pose. Not cute plush toys, no armor, no weapons, no clothes. No floor, background, shadows, scenery, text or borders. Genuinely transparent background.

eye: Create ONE square transparent animation asset: the cream eyeball from TOP LEFT cell of the reference atlas, same fine irregular dark ochre outline, warm pale yellow flat textured shading, exact same hand drawn style. REMOVE its black pupil completely: blank cream eyeball ONLY, no pupil, no iris, no black dot, no stalk, no eyelid, no body. Circle fills exactly 70 percent of canvas width, center at 51 percent horizontal and 55 percent vertical, generous transparent margins. Keep surrounding pixels genuinely transparent. This is a neutral blank eyeball base so a separate pupil and cheese-colored eyelid can be animated in code. No text, no new details.
